body: Reference seam complete for every domain module. Added recall.RecallRef = Unit | Entity | Temporal(from, relation, to) | Causal | Elaboration; align.AlignRef = Cell(unit, AlignState) | Transition(fromUnit, toUnit, fromState, toState) with AlignStateKey.parts/parse public (situation/<id>, segment/<id>, external/<ExternalState>) — so the Recall Voyage vocabulary is addressable per ADR D10. Read API on NarrativeGraph: supporting(ref: StoryRef): Option[SpanSet] (node support for nodes/contexts; the claim's cited spans for edges — never the endpoint hull, per V-E3; None for Containment, which lives in NarrativeHierarchy), covering(span: TextSpan): Vector[StoryRef] (every node, context, and edge whose evidence overlaps the span; deterministic, ordered by address rendering), situationsCovering(span) in discourse order. Verified: JVM story 65/65 (CoveringSuite 5), laws 56/56 (AddressableLaws for Core/Story/Feature/Recall/Align), document 13/13; JS+Native laws/document green; JS+Native story/laws running. Codec milestone spec posted on coordination for codex-storymodel-release. Bead bd-01M14K853WRGGZ2Y5YZ9KWXM6H stays open for: ViewRef assembly (yours, in view), TargetRef/Violation.path migration (after view lands), and hierarchy-aware supporting for Containment on StoryModel. When you are ready for the joint checkpoint, post the view/** file list and I will review against ADR §3–§4.
